relationships.subject: Ginkgolide B
relationships.evidence_quote: GB(4 mg/kg) treatment effectively reduced pain sensation in rats and decreased the expressions of Iba-1 (a microglia marker), NLRP3 inflammasome, and inflammatory factors, such as interleukin (IL)-1β, in the spinal cord 7 days post-surgery.

relationships.subject: Ginkgolide B
relationships.evidence_quote: GB upregulated the expression of mitophagy proteins, such as PINK1, Parkin, LC3 II/I, Tom20, and Beclin1

relationships.subject: Ginkgolide B
relationships.evidence_quote: it lowered the expression of inflammation-related proteins, such as Caspase-1, IL-1β, and NLRP3 in microglia

key_findings: Ginkgolide B reduced pain and spinal NLRP3 inflammasome in CCI rats.
GB suppressed microglial NLRP3/Caspase-1/IL-1β via PINK1-Parkin mitophagy, reversed by Parkin knockdown or 3-MA.
